_scaffold: About Us (/about/), Free Tools (/resources/free-tools/), Contact Us (/contact/) and Blog (/resources/insights/) are Phase 8 pages that don't exist yet — these nav entries will 404 until those pages are built. Paths follow the canonical map in docs/02-sitemap-and-navigation.md.
_structure: Desktop header (docs/13 header restructure, 2026-09-18; nav split rebalanced 2026-09-18): centered logo with primaryLeft/primaryRight flanking it in equal-width grid columns; items with a `children` array render as a hover/click dropdown. Tablet/mobile (<1080px) shows only the centered logo in the header (no nav, no CTAs) — the fixed bottom tab bar (`tabBar`) plus a right-side icon-tile "More" drawer (`more`) reached via the tab bar's last slot carry all navigation instead.
